changes: Independent-review hardening of the external-alpha capability gate. A definitive refusal (403/409 admission DISABLED) is returned only with proof of non-admission, obtained inside the store's serialized admission transaction (global admission lock) together with its database clock. Pricing is judged on that clock, and first admission re-checks the qualified pricing window inside the admission transaction. Any observed prior admission makes the request a replay. A successful prepare makes every later failure ambiguous. Unavailable proof, replay failures and a throwing capability loader without proof are ambiguous 503. Malformed capability configuration no longer blocks read/result/stop. Provisioning refuses unsafe or reserved runtime roles, sets per-binding RLS scope, and renewal never re-enables non-ALLOW/ACTIVE evidence or widens agent capabilities.
externalAlphaFactoryVersion: Derive per approved installation: digest({sourceDigest, configurationDigest: digest(externalAlphaConfiguration(installation))}). Never reuse this production identity or silently replace an installed pin.
qualification: NONE INHERITED. Evidence for earlier FactoryVersions (including 2f30e32e… and 4853cf6c…) does not apply.
installedAuthority: NONE; no installed repin, capability provisioning or enrollment update
